summary: Build practical retention tools, dashboards, and action plans to reduce turnover and strengthen employee experience. Enroll today.
lede: Employee experience training helps HR and people professionals understand how lifecycle touchpoints and management practices influence retention. For HR business partners, people analytics specialists, and employee experience managers, it provides methods to map employee journeys, interpret turnover and listening data, and identify retention risks. Learners also practice planning manager actions and reporting prioritized interventions through a retention dashboard and Balanced Scorecard-aligned people metrics.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage employee experience, interpret retention data, and influence workforce decisions across HR and leadership teams.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of core HR processes, employee relations, performance management, and basic HR reporting. You should be comfortable reading turnover, engagement, and headcount data; no coding is required. Familiarity with pulse surveys, exit interviews, and simple dashboards will help, but the course starts with practical foundations and moves toward applied retention planning.
